title: mentha × verticillata var. ballotifolia
intro: Mentha × verticillata var. ballotifolia, commonly known as Peppermint, is a hybrid of the peppermint plant, resulting from the cross between watermint and spearmint. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including relief from digestive issues, nausea, and headaches, due to its ability to soothe the stomach and calm the mind. The therapeutic actions of Peppermint include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Peppermint include menthol, menthone, limonene, and other essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal and aromatic properties.
